rationale: Direct sponsor and regulatory evidence identifies Meyersdale Storage, LLC as an operating battery project beneath GlidePath Power Solutions, Quinbrook's manager-level portfolio company. NextEra/FPL sold the project company to GlidePath Storage Operations on March 19, 2019. No separate Meyersdale sponsor mandate, project co-owner, later equity transfer or pending transaction was found.
recommendedChanges: Merge/remove the standalone Meyersdale Energy Storage PortCo record into GlidePath Power Solutions.
Preserve Meyersdale Storage, LLC as an 18 MW/12 MWh operating project acquired March 19, 2019 and repowered in late 2024.
Roll Quinbrook fund attribution to GlidePath rather than creating a separate Meyersdale owner row.
Keep Meyersdale Windpower and Green Mountain Storage outside this canonical identity.
Treat 2015 as the service/operating year; do not invent an exact pre-2019 NextEra/FPL equity-entry date.
unresolvedQuestions: The immediate pre-2019 NextEra/FPL member and purchase price are not publicly disclosed.
The Quinbrook fund economic split and project debt terms are not publicly disclosed.
The exact construction-start and repowering dates are not publicly disclosed.
